company.title: Records management from Forge Public Safety
company.description: Forge RMS is part of the Forge platform — one operating system for fire departments and public safety agencies.
paragraphs: Forge RMS provides incident and records management with NFIRS-compliant reporting, narrative tools, and workflows that connect field operations to documentation.
Built by Forge Public Safety, RMS shares authentication, branding, and data standards with Forge Personnel, Training, Fleet, Analytics, and Command.
Departments deploy RMS by station or shift, with implementation support for configuration, data migration, and training.
company.closingDescription: Request a demo to see incident reporting, records workflows, and department portals.
